headline: SpaceDebri rockets from 640th to 88th on ARC-3

sections.text: SpaceDebri climbed 552 places to 88th, reaching 32.93 with a 4.40 gain.
That puts SpaceDebri inside the top 100 on a 4,196-team board, a sharp arrival among the front-running group.
